title: Equipment Carried and Cleaning Standard Held by Each Keyturn Vehicle Listing Class
content:
A vehicle in a Keyturn Vehicle Listing class carries the equipment its class requires, is held to its class's cleaning standard, and carries a telematics unit where the class requires one.

| Class | Telematics unit fitted | Equipment the vehicle must carry | Cleaning standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | not required | spare tyre, jack, first aid kit | standard |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | not required | spare tyre, jack, first aid kit, ice scraper | standard |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | required | spare tyre, jack, first aid kit, ice scraper, tyre inflator | enhanced |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | required | spare tyre, jack, first aid kit, ice scraper, tyre inflator, wheel lock key | enhanced |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | required | first aid kit, tyre inflator, wheel lock key, trickle charger | concierge |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | required | spare tyre, jack, first aid kit, load straps, wheel chocks | standard |

The equipment column is a list of what the class requires, not a list of what the vehicle may carry: a Keyturn Exotic Class Listing requires no spare tyre and no jack, and requires a trickle charger that no other class requires. The three cleaning standards rise in the order standard, enhanced, concierge.
